Prize Package Includes… Title of Miss California Comedy Queen Crown and custom sash $500 cash for Winner $350 cash for 1st Alternate Paid registration for winner & 1st Alternate to Nationals ($500 value) Paid registration for winner & 1st Alternate to Nov. Prelim ($200 value) 2 tickets to Disney World Travel/Lodging Stipend for Orlando Headline a show at Precinct Photo shoot with @talonreedcooper Other paid bookings TBA Custom wig from @outfitterswig Custom ponytail from @mialikeyig Custom Nails from @hunniebunnz Smoothie from @erewhon ! More prizes to be announced! Produced & Hosted by… @anniebiotixx Head Judge… @gisforgodoy from Netflix’s Next in Fashion Honoring the 2026 National Miss Comedy Queen… @gcdrag Music by… @trustfvck Support from… @theonebabu Graphics by… @johnie_supreme Registration is open now! Email CaliforniaComedyQueen@gmail.com or dm @anniebiotxx to ask questions or to register.
